# MagSurveyPy v1.0.0 publication checklist

Before making the repository public and publishing to PyPI:

- [ ] Choose and add a `LICENSE` file. No software license is asserted by this conversion package.
- [ ] Create `https://github.com/alexandruhegyi/MagSurveyPy` or update repository URLs in `pyproject.toml` and `CITATION.cff`.
- [ ] Confirm the `magsurveypy` project name is available on PyPI.
- [ ] Configure PyPI Trusted Publishing for the GitHub repository/environment `pypi`.
- [ ] Run the GitHub Actions CI workflow successfully.
- [ ] Create the GitHub release tag `v1.0.0` only after the public repository is ready.
- [ ] Connect the repository to Zenodo before or immediately after the release if a DOI is desired.
